title: Single-Line Diagram, redrawn
question: Your steer pins the Single-Line Diagram. Two renditions with better graphics: pick one, or steer again.

options.label: SLD · Night panel
options.lineage: LT distribution board drawings, read on a graphite panel
options.thesis: The floor as a live single-line diagram: transformer, meter, main breaker, busbar, one feeder per room.
options.viewport: Rail, KPI strip, the full diagram with AC/fan/light/AV branch counts under each feeder, a waste queue with isolated TRIP buttons, and today's incomer kW ribbon.
options.risk: Dense symbology; the legend and room tags have to carry non-electrical readers.

raised.raise: Panels divide with 1px seams on graphite, and TRIP sits isolated and outlined until deliberately pressed.
Only feeders into empty rooms take the alert colour; everything else stays in neutral ink.
Every figure is set in one monospaced face in tabular columns.

options.label: SLD · Drawing sheet
options.lineage: issued electrical drawing sheets with title blocks
options.thesis: The same diagram as a crisp issued drawing: grid paper, title block, red energised busbar.
options.viewport: Side nav, KPI bar, the diagram on a drawing sheet with title block, and a feeder waste list with TRIP.
options.risk: Light ground in a dim server room all day.

options.label: Dark-first Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels split by hairline seams.
options.case: Your steer pins the diagram; its discipline is folded into the night panel.
options.kept: Hairline seams and isolated TRIP buttons.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: A pulsar plot on matte black, colour coding instead of words.
options.case: Coded labels slow an operator down.
options.kept: Only the active problem takes colour.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Barcode fields in pure black and white.
options.case: Strobing art, not an ops tool.
options.kept: One monospaced face for every figure.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.thesis: Rooms as poster tiles in scrolling rows.
options.case: Browsing metaphor fights a glance-and-act task.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark terminal-style ops dashboard, done properly.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, KPI tiles, charts, room table, event log.
